title: AnimToTextureGenerator
content: A one-click Unreal Engine plugin to convert Skeletal Mesh animations into Vertex Animation Textures (VAT).

title: Getting Started – Install & Use
content:
1. Install the Plugin

  • Copy to Plugins/
  • Enable in Plugins window
  • Restart Editor

2. Open the Tool

  • Open Skeletal Mesh
  • Click "Make Vertex Animation"

3. Generate VAT

  • Select Animations
  • Click Generate

title: Important Notes
content:
Item Description
Generated Assets When generating VAT, the plugin creates the following in the specified directory:
• BoneTexture/ – bone animation textures
• MaterialIns/ – material instances
• Materials/ – materials
• AnimToTextureDataAsset
• Static Mesh assets
Modify Parameters Adjust settings (animation sequences, texture max size, etc.) inside the generated AnimToTextureDataAsset
Regenerate Assets 1. Right-click the DataAsset in the Content Browser
2. Click Run AnimToTexture
3. Assets will be regenerated
Editor Only This plugin is Editor-only and has no runtime cost
Requirements • Skeletal Mesh with valid Animation Sequences
• AnimToTexture plugin enabled
Supported Languages English / Chinese

title: Preview
content:
预览 VAT 动画

  1. 创建一个继承自 BP_PreviewActor 的 Actor
  2. 打开该 Actor
  3. 将生成的 AnimToTextureDataAsset 拖入 DataAsset 变量
  4. 设置动画 Index
  5. 即可在编辑器视口中预览 VAT 动画
